property_summary: For any nonzero account and any token id, calling balanceOf(account,id) on the reference never reverts and returns the stored balance; the mutant removes the zero-address revert which changes behavior for the zero address (it will return a stored balance for address(0)) while the reference reverts — so the universal rule is: balanceOf(address(0), id) always reverts in the reference but not in the mutant.
change_summary: Change the zero-address check to allow zero address and return stored balance (removes revert on zero address).
